name: manuslip
description: Local-first Markdown writing and reading across languages

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.lint: biome lint . && npm run check:layout && npm run check:lockfile && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/patch-micromark-edit-map.mjs --check && node scripts/patch-unist-visit.mjs --check && node scripts/patch-parser-lifetimes.mjs --check && node scripts/patch-micromark-replay.mjs --check && node scripts/patch-definition-list.mjs --check
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --project desktop --project core --project editor --project renderer --project translate
scripts.test:packaging: vitest run --project packaging && node --test test/packaging/lockfile.test.mjs test/packaging/release.test.mjs test/packaging/release-artifacts.test.mjs test/packaging/linux-launcher.test.mjs test/packaging/automation-package.test.mjs
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/patch-micromark-edit-map.mjs && node scripts/patch-unist-visit.mjs && node scripts/patch-parser-lifetimes.mjs && node scripts/patch-micromark-replay.mjs && node scripts/patch-definition-list.mjs && install-electron && npm run install-app-deps --workspace @manuslip/desktop
